title: Ceramic Stash Jar – Stoner Girl
description: The Stoner Girl Jar is a lightweight, discreet storage tool to perfectly store herbs, spices, medicines, teas, coffees, etc… The tight-seal cork lid ensures that herbs are kept fresh for months and that other sensitive materials are protected from light.
